newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices rise, premiums firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices rise, premiums firmer.

text.p: Jet fuel prices gained on benchmark futures on Friday and premiums were steady to slightly firmer, traders said.
Nov IPE futures was trading $1 firmer at $224.75.
One major sold several barges totalling about 15,000 tonnes at Nov IPE +$33.25 to +$33.50 prompt fob ARA, around $1 firmer.

Cargoes were discussed unchanged at Nov IPE +$28/31 cif NWE. In the Med, European Union-qualified material was notionally valued unchanged at around Nov +$14/15. Non EU-qualified was around Nov IPE +$10/11.
